QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`) calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` with its own functions."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init function installs itself via the setter, but it never says it is the only in-tree user of the setter.
